studies.title: Pendampingan Pembuatan Pangan Fungsional Camilan Antihipertensi "Matcha Chips Ubi Jalar" Di Desa Tanjung Pering
studies.abstract: Hipertensi merupakan salah satu penyakit tidak menular (PTM) dengan prevalensi tinggi di Indonesia dan erat kaitannya dengan pola konsumsi makanan tinggi natrium. Desa Tanjung Pering memiliki potensi komoditas lokal berupa ubi jalar yang belum dimanfaatkan secara optimal. Melalui program pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini dilakukan edukasi, pelatihan, dan pendampingan pembuatan camilan “Matcha Chips Ubi Jalar” sebagai pangan fungsional antihipertensi dengan memanfaatkan kandungan kalium, serat, antosianin, dan EGCG dari matcha. Kegiatan dilaksanakan melalui beberapa tahapan: sosialisasi, penyuluhan hipertensi dan gizi, praktik produksi, serta pelatihan higiene pangan. Sebanyak 30 peserta mengikuti kegiatan ini dengan antusias. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa lebih dari 80% peserta memahami proses pembuatan camilan dan manfaatnya bagi kesehatan. Peserta mampu memproduksi produk secara mandiri. Kegiatan ini berhasil meningkatkan pengetahuan kesehatan, keterampilan pengolahan pangan lokal, serta membuka peluang ekonomi berbasis usaha rumah tangga. Produk “Matcha Chips Ubi Jalar” dinilai layak dikembangkan sebagai camilan sehat yang potensial dalam mendukung pencegahan hipertensi di masyarakat.

studies.title: PENGARUH KONTEN MATCHA LATTE DI MEDIA SOSIAL TERHADAP HEDONIC EATING BEHAVIOR DAN AKTIVITAS WISATA KULINER PADA MAHASISWA KOTA BANDUNG
studies.journal: Repository at Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia (Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia)
studies.abstract: The viral phenomenon of matcha latte content on social media has become a strong driver of hedonic consumption behavior and culinary tourism activities among college students, particularly in Bandung City as a hub of student lifestyle and culinary innovation. Studies integrating viral content, Hedonic Eating Behavior, and culinary tourism remain limited, so this study employs the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) framework to explain the underlying mechanism. This study aims to examine the influence of matcha latte content on social media on Hedonic Eating Behavior, the influence of Hedonic Eating Behavior on culinary tourism activities, the direct influence of the content on culinary tourism activities, and the mediating role of Hedonic Eating Behavior, among college students in Bandung City. This quantitative explanatory research involved 150 college student respondents through an online Likert scale (1–5) questionnaire, analyzed using regression-based path analysis (SPSS). The results show that matcha latte content has a significant positive effect on Hedonic Eating Behavior (R²=70.4%) and on culinary tourism activities, both directly and indirectly (R²=77.8%), with Hedonic Eating Behavior serving as a partial mediator. It is recommended that culinary business actors enhance the visual quality of content and the café visiting experience, that students be more mindful of hedonic consumption impulses, and that future research incorporate additional variables such as perceived value or electronic word of mouth. Fenomena viralitas konten matcha latte di media sosial menjadi pendorong kuat perilaku konsumsi hedonis dan aktivitas wisata kuliner mahasiswa, khususnya di Kota Bandung sebagai pusat gaya hidup dan inovasi kuliner. Kajian yang mengaitkan konten viral, Hedonic Eating Behavior, dan wisata kuliner secara terintegrasi masih terbatas, sehingga penelitian ini menggunakan kerangka Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) untuk menjelaskan mekanismenya. Penelitian bertujuan menguji pengaruh konten matcha latte di media sosial terhadap Hedonic Eating Behavior, pengaruh Hedonic Eating Behavior terhadap aktivitas wisata kuliner, pengaruh langsung konten terhadap aktivitas wisata kuliner, serta peran mediasi Hedonic Eating Behavior, pada mahasiswa Kota Bandung. Penelitian kuantitatif eksplanatori ini melibatkan 150 responden mahasiswa melalui kuesioner online Likert 1–5, dianalisis dengan path analysis berbasis regresi (SPSS). Hasil menunjukkan konten matcha latte berpengaruh positif signifikan terhadap Hedonic Eating Behavior (R²=70,4%) dan aktivitas wisata kuliner secara langsung maupun tidak langsung (R²=77,8%), dengan Hedonic Eating Behavior berperan sebagai mediator parsial. Direkomendasikan agar pelaku usaha kuliner meningkatkan kualitas konten visual dan pengalaman berkunjung, mahasiswa lebih bijak menyikapi konsumsi hedonis, serta penelitian lanjutan menambahkan variabel seperti perceived value atau e-WOM.

studies.title: PENGARUH PERCEIVED AUTHENTICITY TERHADAP REVISIT INTENTION MELALUI CUSTOMER SATISFACTION
studies.journal: Repository at Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia (Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia)
studies.abstract: Tren konsumsi Matcha yang semakin meningkat dan menyebar luas di Indonesia mendorong pelaku usaha untuk menciptakan pengalaman konsumsi minuman Matcha yang authentic untuk meningkatkan kepuasan konsumen terhadap harapan dan ekspektasi terhadap produk Matcha yang ditawarkan serta niat konsumen untuk berkunjung kembali. Perceived authenticity atau perspektif keaslian konsumen terhadap produk mampu membentuk persepsi positif pelanggan terhadap kualitas keaslian Matcha yang ditawarkan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode survei melalui penyebaran kuesioner kepada pelanggan Jun Matcha Club. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa perceived authenticity berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap revisit intention. Selain itu, customer satisfaction juga berpengaruh positif serta signifikan terhadap revisit intention dan mampu memediasi pengaruh perceived authenticity untuk meningkatkan revisit intention. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa semakin tinggi persepsi keaslian konsumen terhadap produk Matcha, maka tingkat kepuasan dan niat konsumen untuk kembali dan membeli produk juga akan meningkat. Penelitian ini diharapkan untuk memberikan kontribusi teoritis dalam pengembangan kajian perilaku konsumen pada industri Food and Beverage yang terus berkembang pesat khususnya terhadap trend Matcha, serta diharapkan untuk menjadi masukan bagi Jun Matcha Club dalam meningkatkan strategi pemasaran berbasis pengalaman authentic pelanggan. Kata Kunci: Perceived authenticity, customer satisfaction, revisit intention, Matcha, food and beverage The growing and widespread trend of matcha consumption in Indonesia has encouraged businesses to create an authentic matcha drinking experience to enhance consumer satisfaction regarding their hopes and expectations for the matcha products offered, as well as their intention to return. Perceived authenticity, or consumers’ perspective on a product’s authenticity, can shape customers’ positive perceptions of the quality and authenticity of the matcha offered. This study employs a quantitative approach using a survey method by distributing questionnaires to Jun Matcha Club customers. The results of this research indicate that perceived authenticity has a positive and significant effect on revisit intention. Additionally, customer satisfaction also has a positive and significant effect on revisit intention and mediates the influence of perceived authenticity in increasing revisit intention. Thus, this indicates that the higher consumers’ perceived authenticity of Matcha products, the higher their satisfaction levels and their intention to return and purchase the product will be. This study is expected to contribute theoretically to the development of consumer behavior research in the rapidly growing Food and Beverage industry—particularly regarding the Matcha trend—and is also intended to provide insights for Jun Matcha Club in enhancing its marketing strategies based on authentic customer experiences. Keywords: Perceived authenticity, customer satisfaction, revisit intention, Matcha, food and beverage

studies.title: PENGEMBANGAN KULIT PANGSIT MENJADI PANGSIT ROLL LUMER BERBAGAI VARIAN RASA BY SUJAJEMI
studies.abstract: Pangsit roll lumer is an innovative food product that transforms traditional dumpling wrappers into a modern snack with flavor varieties applied on the outside, such as chocolate, matcha, and tiramisu. This study aims to analyze the product development process, sensory evaluation, and market competitiveness assessment of pangsit roll lumer. The methods employed include production, observation, and interviews. The results indicate that pangsit roll lumer with chocolate, matcha, and tiramisu flavors received positive responses from consumers in terms of taste, aroma, color, and texture. Physicochemical analysis shows that the product remains safe for consumption and has high economic value and market competitiveness. This innovation opens opportunities for the development of snack industries based on traditional foods and can inspire other MSMEs to create innovative and competitive products.

studies.title: Pengembangan Produk Gethuk Dessert Box Berbasis Inovasi Cita Rasa sebagai Strategi Penetrasi Pasar Kuliner Kekinian
studies.abstract: Gethuk adalah makanan tradisional khas Jawa Tengah yang dimana gethuk merupakan makanan pokok orang zaman dahulu. Makanan ini terbuat dari bahan dasar singkong sehingga dapat mengenyangkan dan sangat disukai oleh orang tua, namun pada saat ini makanan ini sangat jarang ditemui dan anak muda juga lebih tertarik dengan makanan yang lebih modern. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji pengembangan prototype produk gethuk Dessert Box sebagai strategi untuk masuk ke dalam pasar modern, dengan menginovasi rasa dan desain kemasan yang lebih modern dan disukai oleh anak muda. Produk Gethuk Dessert Box ini memiliki 3 varian rasa yang berbeda dan sedang tren di kalangan anak muda (GenZ) yaitu Matcha, Coklat, dan Tiramisu, dan dikemas dalam kemasan Dessert Box yang sedang dalam tren saat ini. Metode yang digunakan mencakup perencanaan konsep produk, uji coba formula, evaluasi sensoris, dan analisis respons konsumen. Hasil menunjukkan produk mendapat respon positif dari kalangan konsumen usia 18 sampai 25 tahun yang menyukai kombinasi nilai tradisional dengan tampilan modern. Produk ini mungkin menjadi contoh inovasi makanan lokal yang bisa bersaing di pasar makanan modern sekaligus berperan dalam menjaga warisan kuliner Indonesia.

studies.title: Perancangan cup set matcha stoneware bergaya Japandi
studies.journal: PRODUCTUM Jurnal Desain Produk (Pengetahuan dan Perancangan Produk)
studies.abstract: The trend of matcha consumption continues to experience growing interest throughout Indonesia in 2025. This phenomenon presents an opportunity for the ceramics industry regarding the need for matcha consumption serving ware. This research aims to design a cup set using stoneware material, employing a User-Centered Design approach that focuses on user needs and preferences. To achieve this objective, the research begins with an industry analysis at a local pottery studio called Biomorphic, which uses stoneware material in its products. The research was conducted by identifying production potential and capacity using SWOT analysis tools. Subsequently, a market validation stage was carried out using Google Trends, and user needs analysis with a case study approach at a Japandi-style café as a reference for taste and presentation preferences. Design decision-making utilized visual scale analysis tools and product positioning. The research results comprise a cup set prototype using stoneware material with Japandi aesthetics in accordance with user needs. Validation was conducted through field testing, which demonstrated that the design aligns with Japandi interior aesthetics and fulfills the serving function for cafés. Published Date: 2026-07-26

studies.title: Perceived Value Drivers of Willingness to Pay : Evidence from Generation Z Matcha Consumption in Western Café Markets
studies.abstract: Social media's increasing influence has changed how customers see and assess food and beverage items, shaping not only what consumers buy but also how much they are willing to pay for it. Despite its unusual flavor, matcha, a traditional Japanese green tea, has recently become more well-known in Western markets and is frequently marketed as a high-end product. This study looks at how Generation Z consumers' willingness to pay (WTP) for matcha beverages is influenced by perceived value dimensions shaped within social media environments. The study uses a mixed-method approach based on the Theory of Consumption Values (TCV), combining a netnographic analysis with a quantitative survey. In the first phase, 964 comments from TikTok and YouTube Shorts were analyzed to explore how consumers organically discuss and evaluate matcha online. The findings showed that taste polarization and customization were the most discussed topics, while social and health dimensions appeared less frequently than expected. In the second phase, a survey of 100 Generation Z consumers from Europe and North America was conducted to examine the relationship between perceived value dimensions and willingness to pay. The results show that while all five TCV dimensions positively correlate with willingness to pay, only emotional value emerged as a statistically significant predictor. Taste-related skepticism remains a barrier to price acceptance, while social media contributes indirectly by increasing perceived value through visual appeal and social validation. By connecting social media-driven value perceptions to willingness to pay, this study contributes to the existing literature on consumer behavior, digital marketing, and food and beverage consumption, and provides useful recommendations for marketing matcha as a premium product to Generation Z consumers.

studies.title: Phytochemical Analysis on Matcha Product Content in Gorontalo City
studies.journal: International Journal of Health Economics and Social Sciences (IJHESS)
studies.abstract: Matcha is known to have a high content of bioactive compounds compared to regular green tea. This is because matcha is consumed in the form of a whole powder, so that all the compounds in tea leaves are also consumed. In Gorontalo City, matcha drinks are becoming more and more popular so KL, NK, and RHU were chosen as the sampling locations because they offer a variety of matcha products. The formulation of the problem in this study is what are the ingredients contained in matcha products in Gorontalo City. This study aims to identify and analyze the content contained in matcha products. This study uses a quantitative descriptive design to determine the content of matcha through phytochemical analysis. The study population included matcha drinks from 25 coffee shops and 8 street coffees in Gorontalo City, with samples taken from KL, RHU, and NK. The results showed that the RHU sample had the highest total phenol content of 209.34 mg GAE/g, followed by NK 184.64 mg GAE/g, and KL 149.30 mg GAE/g. The mean value of IC₅₀ showed that the antioxidant activity of RHU was very strong (34.87 ppm), strong NK (52.41 ppm), and moderate KL (109.32 ppm). In conclusion, KL, NK, and RHU matcha samples in Gorontalo City are still safe to consume based on their phenol content. The antioxidant activity of the KL sample is moderate, NK is strong, and RHU is very strong, it is recommended to consume matcha wisely and business actors need to pay attention to the quality of raw materials and processing processes to maintain the content of active compounds of the product.

studies.title: Preferencje konsumentów wobec nabywania i spożywania japońskiej herbaty matcha
studies.journal: Prace Naukowe Uniwersytetu Ekonomicznego we Wrocławiu
studies.abstract: Cel: Celem artykułu było poznanie wiedzy respondentów na temat herbaty matcha, częstotliwości jej spożycia i czynników wpływających na decyzje zakupowe tej herbaty na polskim rynku. Metodyka: Badanie przeprowadzono za pomocą ankiet internetowych wspomaganych komputerowo (Computer Assisted Web Interview, CAWI) przy użyciu autorskiego kwestionariusza. Ankiety przeprowadzono wśród 277 respondentów spożywających matchę, w wieku 18-65 lat, w okresie od kwietnia do lipca 2025 roku. Do analizy badanych zmiennych nominalnych i porządkowych wykorzystano test niezależności chi-kwadrat Pearsona, z użyciem pakietu programu Statistica. Wyniki: Udział matchy w diecie respondentów determinuje głównie status społeczno-ekonomiczny. Odsetek konsumentów regularnie spożywających matchę nie jest duży i wynosi 20% badanej populacji. Większość respondentów wiedziała, że matcha zawiera antyoksydanty, jednakże badani nie potrafili wskazać, że są to związki polifenolowe. Niemal wszyscy respondenci mieli świadomość, że sposób przygotowania matchy wpływa na jej właściwości przeciwutleniające. Trend wirtualizacji konsumpcji uwidacznia się w decyzjach zakupowych tej herbaty. Implikacje i rekomendacje: Producenci napojów prozdrowotnych powinni skupić się na lepszej komunikacji marketingowej promującej zdrowe nawyki żywieniowe i podkreślającej korzyści ze spożywania matchy. Działania takie przyczynią się do wzrostu świadomości konsumentów w zakresie właściwości prozdrowotnych matchy, a tym samym – wzrostu konsumpcji napojów prozdrowotnych. Oryginalność/wartość: Zastosowany kwestionariusz pozwolił na poznanie różnic między grupami konsumentów i wskazanie ich indywidualnych preferencji wobec japońskiej zielonej herbaty matcha, a także umożliwił identyfikację istotnych czynników w kontekście nabywania tego produktu.

studies.title: Prioritizing Matcha Green Tea Production Criteria by Logarithmic Fuzzy FUCOM with Z-Numbers
studies.abstract: The rapid growth of the global matcha market requires manufacturers to develop systematic tools for production planning under uncertainty. Matcha manufacturing involves multiple interdependent criteria, including cost, tea raw material quality, physicochemical properties, sensory attributes, and dissolvability, each contributing differently to overall product performance and consumer acceptance. Experts' opinions are not only vague but also differ in reliability, which limits the effectiveness of conventional Multi-Criteria Decision-Making (MADM) methods that treat all expert opinions equally. To address this limitation, this paper presents the Logarithmic Fuzzy Full Consistency Method with Z-numbers (LF-Z-FUCOM), which integrates fuzzy sets, logarithmic preference programming, and Z-numbers into a unified weighting framework. The proposed method allows both the importance of criteria and the confidence level of expert assessments to be incorporated directly into the weight estimation process. A real-world case study was conducted on matcha green tea production in Thailand. The results are compared with those obtained from the conventional FUCOM and Fuzzy FUCOM methods. The findings demonstrate that LF-Z-FUCOM provides more discriminative and reliability-consistent criterion weights, clearly identifying cost (0.3208) and tea raw material quality (0.2829) as the dominant factors, whereas FUCOM and Fuzzy FUCOM fail to sufficiently separate closely ranked criteria. The proposed method improves decision transparency, consistency, and managerial interpretability in uncertain multi-criteria environments.

studies.title: PROGRAM PELATIHAN KETERAMPILAN PADA ANAK BINAAN DI LEMBAGA PEMBINAAN KHUSUS ANAK (LPKA) KELAS II PROVINSI BENGKULU
studies.journal: University of Bengkulu Scholar Repository (University of Bengkulu)
studies.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan program pelatihan keterampilan pada anak binaan di Lembaga Pembinaan Khusus Anak (LPKA) Kelas II Provinsi Bengkulu. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui wawancara, observasi dan dokumentasi dengan melibatkan kepala seksi pembinaan, instruktur pelatihan dan anak binaan. Keabsahan data diuji melalui triangulasi sumber, teknik, dan waktu. Teknik analisis data meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa program pelatihan keterampilan yang dilaksanakan di LPKA Kelas II Provinsi Bengkulu terdiri atas empat jenis pelatihan, yaitu pelatihan pangkas rambut, pelatihan hidroponik, pelatihan barista, serta pelatihan hand bouquet & signage akrilik. Program pelatihan tersebut memberikan pengetahuan kepada anak binaan sesuai dengan jenis pelatihan yang diikuti. Meskipun sebagian besar anak binaan belum pernah mengikuti pelatihan sebelumnya, mereka memperoleh pengetahuan mengenai teknik mencukur rambut, tahapan budidaya hidroponik, teknik pembuatan kopi dan matcha, serta membuat bunga dari kawat bulu dan merangkai bunga artificial pada papan akrilik. Dari empat materi pelatihan yang diberikan, pelatihan pangkas rambut dan hidroponik diterapkan secara berkelanjutan sehingga anak binaan tidak hanya memahami materi, tetapi juga mampu menerapkannya dalam kegiatan pangkas rambut dan budidaya tanaman hidroponik. Selanjutnya, program pelatihan memberikan keterampilan kepada anak binaan melalui kegiatan praktik secara langsung. Kegiatan praktik tersebut tidak hanya memberikan keterampilan pada anak binaan selama mengikuti pembinaan, tetapi juga bekal ketika mereka kembali ke masyarakat. Program pelatihan menerapkan metode ceramah, demonstrasi, dan praktik langsung yang saling melengkapi, sehingga anak binaan memperoleh pengetahuan, memahami teknik melalui peragaan, serta mendapatkan keterampilan melalui praktik secara langsung. Program pelatihan di LPKA Kelas II Provinsi Bengkulu juga menerapkan kegiatan kerja sama yang disesuaikan dengan karakteristik jenis pelatihan. Kegiatan tersebut menumbuhkan sikap kerja sama pada anak binaan, yang ditunjukkan melalui kemauan kerja sama dengan sesama anak binaan maupun petugas pembinaan. Kata Kunci : Anak binaan, pelatihan, keterampilan, LPKA

studies.title: RINTISAN USAHA GOMILK DI TINJAU DARI ASPEK PRODUKSI DAN KEUANGAN = GOMILK BUSINESS START-UP REVIEWED FROM PRODUCTION AND FINANCIAL ASPECTS
studies.abstract: Peluang pengembangan produk olahan susu kambing di Kabupaten Soppeng cukup besar seiring meningkatnya kebutuhan masyarakat terhadap produk pangan yang praktis, bergizi, dan memiliki nilai tambah. GOMILK hadir sebagai usaha rintisan yang mengolah susu kambing menjadi berbagai varian minuman dan keripik susu kambing. Namun, untuk mendukung keberlanjutan usaha, diperlukan pengelolaan aspek produksi yang terencana dan manajemen keuangan yang terstruktur. Tujuan Kegiatan ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis dan menerapkan aspek produksi serta aspek keuangan dalam mendukung keberlanjutan dan daya saing usaha GOMILK. Aspek produksi difokuskan pada pengelolaan bahan baku, proses produksi, pengendalian mutu, dan pengembangan produk, sedangkan aspek keuangan meliputi pencatatan keuangan, penyusunan anggaran biaya, penetapan harga jual, dan analisis Break Even Point (BEP). Hasil Hasil pelaksanaan usaha menunjukkan bahwa GOMILK berhasil mengembangkan produk susu kambing varian gula aren, kopi gula aren, sarabba, matcha, serta keripik susu kambing yang diterima oleh konsumen. Penjualan produk mengalami peningkatan selama periode usaha berjalan seiring dengan promosi yang dilakukan melalui media sosial dan penjualan langsung. Pengelolaan keuangan yang dilakukan secara rutin membantu mengendalikan biaya usaha, sedangkan analisis BEP menunjukkan titik impas usaha susu kambing berada pada 140 unit dan keripik susu kambing pada 14 unit sehingga dapat menjadi dasar dalam menetapkan target penjualan. Kesimpulan Usaha GOMILK memiliki prospek yang baik untuk dikembangkan sebagai usaha olahan susu kambing bernilai tambah. Penerapan manajemen produksi yang terencana, inovasi produk yang berkelanjutan, serta pengelolaan keuangan yang disiplin menjadi faktor penting dalam meningkatkan daya saing, menjaga keberlanjutan usaha, dan mendukung pengembangan bisnis di masa mendatang.

studies.title: Science, Federal Policy, Direct Advocacy, and Future Policy: Audience Perception on the Impact of Intense Caffeinated Beverages on the Human Neuromuscular System.
studies.abstract: Abstract Background Caffeine, the world’s most widely consumed psychoactive substance, modulates neuromuscular function, enhancing reaction time, muscle contraction, and endurance at moderate doses, but provoking tremors, fatigue, and coordination deficits at high intake. Beyond physiology, public understanding of these effects is increasingly mediated by video-based content, intertwining scientific knowledge with perception, communication, and policy influence. Objective This study explores how audiences interpret the neuromuscular impact of intense caffeinated beverages through digital media, investigating how narrative framing shapes comprehension, emotional response, and engagement, and how these perceptions align with biomedical evidence and regulatory guidance. Methods Twenty-three student projects analyzing videos from TED-Ed, Institute of Human Anatomy, Doctor Mike, Dartmouth Health, and High Spirit Pharmacist were assessed using qualitative content and sentiment analysis via the Communalytic tool. Scientific accuracy, tone, and audience reactions were examined, contextualized by peer-reviewed literature and authoritative health sources (FDA, CDC, Mayo Clinic, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, 2023). Results Audiences universally recognized caffeine’s action as an adenosine receptor antagonist and understood dose-dependent effects relative to the FDA’s 400 mg/day guideline. Perceptions varied by beverage: matcha and cacao were highly favorable, coffee neutral, and soda and energy drinks elicited concern. Engagement correlated with framing: evidence-based videos promoted constructive discourse, whereas promotional content triggered polarized sentiment. Moderate caffeine (≤ 6 mg/kg/day) enhanced neuromuscular performance; excessive intake (> 8 mg/kg/day) induced fatigue, tremors, and receptor desensitization. Conclusions Audience perception is co-shaped by physiology and media framing. Translating neuromuscular science into effective public understanding requires strategic science communication, advocacy, and policy alignment. This research underscores the need for integrative approaches bridging evidence, media, and regulatory frameworks to guide safe caffeine consumption and health literacy.

studies.title: Sensory and nutritional properties of matcha infusions enriched with Qassim blackberries: effects of thermal processing on phenolic profile, color, and antioxidant activity
studies.journal: International Journal of Food Science & Technology
studies.abstract: Abstract Matcha is recognised for its rich phytochemical composition, while blackberries are abundant in anthocyanins and phenolic compounds. This study evaluated the sensory properties, phenolic profile, colour dynamics, and antioxidant potential of pure matcha (MT) and a matcha beverage formulated with 15% Qassim blackberry powder (BL) at three extraction temperatures (5 °C, 70 °C, 100 °C). Sensory evaluation used a 9-point hedonic scale with 50 panelists. Colour parameters (L, a, b, chroma, hue, ΔE) were measured via chromameter. Total phenolics (TPC), flavonoids, anthocyanins, vitamin C, and individual phenolic compounds were quantified by spectrophotometry and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC). Antioxidant activity was assessed by 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) and 2,2′-azino-bis(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonic acid) (ABTS) assays. The 15% blackberry formulation achieved the highest sensory acceptability (8.43–8.45). BL exhibited acidic pH (3.60–3.82) versus MT (6.20–6.30). TPC reached 71.07 mg gallic acid equivalents/100 ml in BL at 100 °C (25% higher than MT). Anthocyanins were detected only in BL and decreased with temperature (69.14 → 27.12 mg/100 g). Vitamin C was highest at 5 °C (140.94 mg/100 g). BL demonstrated superior antioxidant activity, with IC50 (half-maximal inhibitory concentration) values of 169.9 μg/ml (DPPH) and 226.1 μg/ml (ABTS) at 100 °C, representing 60%–70% improvement over MT. Strong correlations (r > 0.94) between phenolic content and antioxidant activity were observed. Incorporating 15% blackberry powder into matcha yields a functional beverage with enhanced sensory appeal, improved phenolic profile, and potent antioxidant capacity.

studies.title: Silver nanoparticles using matcha tea and its bactericidal effect to inhibit the growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
Single intake of matcha increases brown adipose tissue activity in young women with low thermogenesis.
studies.abstract: Matcha contains several bioactive compounds that contribute to the facilitation of thermogenesis. However, the effects of a single intake of matcha on brown adipose tissue (BAT) activity remain to be elucidated. This study aimed to evaluate the association between matcha intake and BAT activity. Healthy young women (n = 30) were enrolled in a randomized single-blind crossover trial. Participants consumed 3 g of matcha powder or a placebo and then received the alternate condition in a subsequent trial. BAT activity was analyzed using thermography with cold exposure. A stratified analysis was performed based on tertiles of maximal changes in BAT activity. BAT activity was increased for all participants following cold exposure; however, no significant difference in the increased levels was found between the matcha and placebo trials. Stratified analysis showed that BAT activity was significantly different in the placebo trial across the low, middle, and high tertile groups; however, this was not found in the matcha trial. Differences in maximal BAT activity between the matcha and placebo trials were significantly higher in the low activity group than in the other groups. These results suggest that matcha powder has beneficial effects on BAT thermogenesis in young women with lower BAT activity.

studies.title: Sip and Strum: Matcha Intake and a Practice-Reduction Reinforcement Contingency in Beginner Ukulele Skill Acquisition
studies.journal: International Journal of Behavioral and Social Analytics
studies.abstract: This study examined differences in beginner ukulele skill acquisition under three combinations of matcha intake and a practice-reduction reinforcement contingency. A quasi-experimental three-group design was employed involving 15 students aged 18–25 years with no prior musical-instrument experience. Participants were assigned to one of three conditions: no matcha with reinforcement, matcha with reinforcement, or matcha without reinforcement. The reinforcement contingency consisted of shortening the remaining practice period when a participant attained at least 85% performance accuracy at the prescribed tempo twice consecutively. Participants completed two structured practice sessions, followed by retention assessments conducted 24–48 hours after learning. Musical performance was evaluated using accuracy, tempo maintenance, criterion attainment, correct chord progressions, and retention scores. Descriptive results showed that the matcha-with-reinforcement group exhibited the strongest overall performance, including more frequent tempo maintenance, higher criterion attainment, and more correct chord progressions. This group also obtained the highest mean retention score. Welch’s one-way analysis of variance indicated a statistically significant difference in retention across the three conditions, with the matcha-with-reinforcement group outperforming the matcha-only group. However, the small sample and absence of a no-matcha-without-reinforcement condition preclude separate estimates of the two interventions and any conclusion regarding their interaction. The findings provide preliminary evidence that combining physiological stimulation with a structured practice-reduction contingency may support beginner musical learning, although confirmation through a larger, complete factorial experiment is required.

studies.title: Synergistic Effects of Nanoselenium and Environmental Factors on the Quality, Antioxidant Activity, and Gut Health Benefits of Matcha.
studies.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
studies.abstract: This study investigated the synergistic effects of nanoselenium foliar fertilization, cultivar, altitude, and light exposure on matcha quality and functionality. Among 16 different cultivation treatments, the best quality matcha was found in the selenium-enriched, high-altitude shaded cv. Fuyun No. 6 group, which exhibited the highest theanine content, the lowest polyphenol-to-amino acid ratio, and the best sensory score. Simulated gastrointestinal digestion showed that selenium-enriched matcha had higher 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl scavenging activity compared with regular matcha. In vivo selenium biofortification enhanced glutathione peroxidase activity and reduced the malondialdehyde content in the liver and kidneys. It also increased the expression of intestinal barrier proteins Claudin-1 and Occludin, protecting gut integrity. Additionally, selenium-enriched matcha reshaped the gut microbiota by promoting beneficial bacteria such as Ligilactobacillus (family Lactobacillaceae ). These findings highlight the optimal cultivation conditions for selenium-enriched matcha and demonstrate its potential as a functional food with enhanced antioxidant and gut health benefits.

studies.title: Synergistic enhancement of matcha tea with strawberry (Qassim region) aqueous extracts: influence of extraction temperature on phytochemicals, vitamin C, and bioactivities.
studies.abstract: Introduction: Matcha tea is renowned for its rich phytochemical profile; however, optimizing its bioactive potential through formulation and extraction conditions requires further investigation. This study tested the hypothesis that strawberry powder creates an acidic microenvironment that stabilizes matcha catechins during thermal extraction while contributing complementary bioactives. Methods: Aqueous extracts from pure matcha (MT) and an 85:15 matcha-strawberry blend (ST) were prepared at 5 °C, 70 °C, and 100 °C. Total phenolics, flavonoids, anthocyanins, vitamin C, individual phenolic compounds (HPLC), and in vitro antioxidant (DPPH, ABTS) and anti-inflammatory activities were evaluated. Two-way ANOVA and a Synergistic Enhancement Index (SEI) were used to quantify formulation × temperature interactions. Results and discussion: The ST blend exhibited a significantly lower pH (∼3.70) compared to MT (∼6.20-6.30), remaining stable across all temperatures. This acidic environment dramatically enhanced catechin recovery: at 70 °C, SEI = +24.8% (2631.18 vs. 2109.08 μg/g); at 100 °C, SEI = +28.9% (2042.11 vs. 1584.33 μg/g). Strawberry substitution introduced protocatechuic acid, cinnamic acid, and anthocyanins (13.89-35.14 mg/100 g). Antioxidant activity peaked at 100 °C for ST (80.21% DPPH, 81.34% ABTS), representing a 34.9% enhancement over MT. Anti-inflammatory activity was highest at 70 °C (85.52% inhibition). Vitamin C and anthocyanins were optimally preserved at 5 °C, with ST providing 2.5-fold higher concentrations. Two-way ANOVA confirmed significant formulation × temperature interactions for all major outcomes (p < 0.01). Conclusion: Strategic formulation with strawberry powder fundamentally alters the thermal extraction window of matcha. Brewing the blend at 100 °C maximizes antioxidant potential, while 70 °C optimizes anti-inflammatory effects, and cold brewing at 5 °C preserves heat-labile nutrients. These findings enable targeted functional beverage development through precise temperature control and synergistic ingredient blending.

studies.title: Té matcha: composición, características sensoriales y efectos en la salud bucal
studies.abstract: Objetivo: analizar la evidencia sobre la composición, las características sensoriales y los efectos sobre la salud bucal del té matcha y del té verde. Métodos: revisión de la literatura con síntesis narrativa en PubMed, SciELO y DOAJ; se seleccionaron 15 documentos. Resultados: el matcha contiene 2213,5 µg/g de cafeína, 56,1 g/100 g de fibra y catequinas como la epigalocatequina galato. Su perfil sensorial depende de la variedad y del procesamiento. En ensayos clínicos, los enjuagues de té verde al 0,5 % redujeron Streptococcus mutans y lactobacilos salivales, y el té verde redujo la interleucina 1β salival en la periodontitis crónica. Los extractos inhibieron la biopelícula de S. mutans, aunque los pigmentos del té pueden producir manchas extrínsecas. Conclusión: el té verde, del que deriva el matcha, muestra efectos antimicrobianos y antiinflamatorios con potencial preventivo, pero faltan ensayos clínicos con matcha.

studies.title: Tea Cultures of Japan
studies.abstract: Abstract In the 21st century, the archaic form of powdered green tea, matcha, has become a global superfood fad, bringing the traditional practices that maintained matcha production for centuries into greater visibility as well. This article surveys the major historical uses of tea in Japan from introduction of the substance until the present day. Special focus is concentrated on matcha and the “Japanese tea ceremony” that has come to define Japanese high culture and persists as a living practice centered on a consumable beverage but also encompassing arts, philosophies, and political histories.

studies.title: Tea in the History of Japan's Global Interfaces
studies.abstract: Hellyer uses the case of tea to illuminate Japan&s;s long global entanglements. Beginning with its eighth-century transmission from China, he tracks how practices like matcha and sencha emerged through technological borrowings and shifting domestic tastes, while Edo-period trade tied Japan into Chinese-centred circuits of silver, copper, and medicinal goods. With the treaty ports from 1859, Japan entered the American-dominated green tea market, even outcompeting China by the late nineteenth century. When US consumers turned to Indian and Ceylonese black teas in the 1920s, Japanese producers redirected surplus sencha inward, promoting it as a healthful national drink. Hellyer argues that iconic elements of Japanese culture—today epitomized by sencha and matcha—were shaped not by isolation but by sustained links with China and evolving demands of Western markets.

studies.title: Tea Inn
studies.abstract: Menu from Tea Inn restaurant in China. Fresh fruit tea series, milk series, yakult series, kyoto uji matcha series, tea series, classic hot drink seres.

studies.title: Tea-Derived Beverages Worldwide: A Critical Review of Diversity, Chemistry, Processing and Consumption Trends
studies.journal: Journal of Advances in Biology & Biotechnology
studies.abstract: Tea-derived beverages constitute a globally distributed but analytically heterogeneous family extending from minimally transformed leaf infusions to oxidised, post-fermented, powdered, concentrated, ready-to-drink and composite milk- or sugar-containing products. Their common botanical origin can obscure the extent to which cultivar, leaf maturity, manufacturing sequence, extraction conditions, microbial ecology, formulation and storage redefine the beverage actually consumed. This critical narrative review integrates evidence on beverage diversity, chemical architecture, processing-induced transformation and consumption patterns. Literature published from January 2000 to 20 May 2026 was identified through accessible scholarly indexes, bibliographic databases, DOI records and citation chaining, with inclusion governed by verifiable metadata, methodological relevance and direct support for the synthesis. The evidence indicates that the conventional six-tea classification remains useful for production and cultural description but incompletely predicts beverage chemistry. Oxidation, heating and microbial conversion redistribute catechins, polymeric pigments, amino acids, alkaloids, organic acids and volatile compounds, while brewing and formulation determine their transfer, stability and sensory expression. Post-fermented teas and kombucha share microbial transformation but differ fundamentally in substrate, ecology, control points and safety concerns. Ready-to-drink, instant, cold-brew, matcha, milk tea and bubble tea formats widen access and sensory diversity, yet complicate comparison because processing severity, solids intake, sweeteners and matrix interactions are often poorly reported. Consumption evidence confirms broad geographic expansion and product diversification, but most surveys measure cups or beverage categories rather than chemical exposure. The main research need is therefore not another universal ranking of tea types, but interoperable product definitions, process-aware chemical reporting and formulation-sensitive consumption surveillance. A unified approach linking raw material, unit operations, beverage matrix, storage, sensory outcomes and consumption context would improve quality control, cross-study comparability and interpretation of tea-derived beverages as foods rather than undifferentiated carriers of selected bioactives.

studies.title: The effect of tea ceremony to reduce stress for older people living with dementia and their caregivers
studies.abstract: Aotearoa New Zealand (NZ) and Japan are both experiencing with the rapid growth of ageing populations, leading to significant health, societal, and economic challenges. Aged residential care facilities (ARCs) are essential for providing comprehensive health care, companionship, and safety for older people living with dementia (OPWD). However, ARCs face numerous challenges in delivering optimal care, including the unmet needs of care, such as residents’ loneliness and limited capacity and resources. Furthermore, nursing staff report high levels of stress and burnout in responding to responsive reactive behaviour of OPWD without effective training or support, leading to high turnover and workforce shortages. Our project addresses the urgent need to support both OPWD and carers. Evidence shows that greenspace exposure, Matcha consumption (green tea), and engaging in tea ceremonies can enhance physical, social, mental, and spiritual well-being. Our novel project brings these interventions together to support OPWD and carers’ well-being, through shared tea ceremonies, involving matcha intake and mindfulness of viewing greenspace such as a flower arrangement (ikebana) or Bonsai (a miniature tree)2. We will explore opportunities and challenges to undertaking this novel intervention in Japan and NZ. By exploring the existed literature of mindfulness-based intervention to reduce stress of OPWD and their caregivers, we will define how tea ceremony can be a potential mindfulness-based intervention for them as a dyadic application.

studies.title: The Effects of Matcha on the Functioning of Selected Body Systems: A Literature Review
studies.journal: Journal of Education Health and Sport
studies.abstract: Matcha, a powdered green tea originating from Japan, is a rich source of polyphenols, catechins, L-theanine, caffeine, vitamins, and minerals. This review summarizes current evidence regarding the potential effects of matcha consumption on selected physiological systems and overall human health. Available data suggest that regular intake of matcha may exert beneficial effects on the cardiovascular system and demonstrate antioxidant, anticancer, and neuroprotective properties, while also supporting stress reduction and cognitive function. However, the magnitude of these effects appears to depend on factors such as the quality of raw materials, cultivation conditions, and preparation methods. Although existing findings are promising, a substantial proportion of the available evidence originates from in vitro studies, animal models, and limited clinical trials, which restricts the strength of current conclusions. Therefore, matcha should be considered a complementary component of a healthy diet rather than a substitute for established preventive or therapeutic strategies. Further well-designed clinical studies involving larger populations and longer follow-up periods are required to more precisely determine its potential impact on human health.

studies.title: The Impact of Matcha and Coffee on ADHD
studies.journal: Digital Commons - LIU Promoting Scholarship and Creative Work of LIU Students, Faculty, and Staff (Long Island University)
studies.abstract: INTRODUCTION: One of the main signs of ADHD is issues with focus, which often lead people to turn to stimulants like coffee for help in concentration. However, the caffeine in coffee may trigger temporary spikes that result in crashes, which may make prolonged focus worse. Caffeine and L-theanine, a substance linked with reduced alertness and lowered jitteriness, are both found in matcha, a powdered green tea. Despite the fact both of the drinks are common, little research has been done to assess how they influence attention in people with ADHD. The objective of this study is to find out whether matcha, as compared to coffee, promotes and maintains attention in individuals with ADHD. METHOD: A convenience sample of 33 college students were asked to complete a Stroop task and then fill out a Google Form with corresponding questions. Participants were classified into a caffeine group (n=18) and a no-caffeine group (n=15) based on if they reported caffeine consumption that day. Additional self report variables assessed sleep and tiredness as potential factors of interference. Participants were recruited using social media and close family contacts. They completed the form online, where they documented their caffeine consumption, completed the Stroop task, recorded their completion time and answered questions about sleep. RESULTS: An independent samples t-test showed that participants who consumed caffeine (M=29.3, SD=8.39) had slightly longer stroop task completion times than those who did not consume caffeine (M=27.7, SD=7.66), but it was not statistically significant, (31) = -0.567, p=.575. DISCUSSION/CONCLUSION: Caffeine consumption was not associated with improved attentional performance, in this study because there was no noteworthy variation between the two groups. The results do not support the hypothesis because factors such as sleep, individual tolerance differences, and uncontrollable variables may have influenced the findings.

studies.title: The Impact of Matcha Green Tea on Human Health – Mechanisms of Action, Clinical Evidence, and Health Effects
studies.abstract: Matcha green tea, a powdered whole-leaf preparation from shade-grown Camellia sinensis, exhibits a unique biochemical profile rich in catechins (particularly EGCG), L-theanine, caffeine, and chlorophyll, distinguishing it from conventional green teas. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on matcha's composition, mechanisms of action, and health effects. Mechanistically, EGCG activates the Nrf2/Keap1 antioxidant pathway, suppresses inflammatory signaling, and synergizes with L-theanine/caffeine to enhance cognitive function, while modulating gut microbiota toward beneficial taxa like Coprococcus. Clinical and preclinical studies demonstrate cardiometabolic benefits including improved glycemic control, lipid profiles, and hepatic protection against NAFLD, alongside cognitive enhancements and reduced exercise-induced fatigue. Preliminary data suggest anti-cancer potential via apoptosis induction and metabolic inhibition in tumor cells. Despite promising mechanistic insights, human trials remain limited by small samples, short durations, and heterogeneous preparations. Matcha emerges as a functional food with multifaceted health potential, warranting large-scale randomized controlled trials to establish optimal dosing, long-term efficacy, and safety for evidence-based recommendations.

studies.title: The Maintenance and Repair Balance Theory of Aging: A Personal, Illustrated Hypothesis on Why Aging May Be a Problem of Damage, Not Time
studies.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
studies.abstract: IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ FIRST: The author is NOT a physician or any kind of medical professional. This paper is a personal conceptual hypothesis written by a layperson. It is NOT medical advice, NOT a diagnosis, and NOT a treatment recommendation. Some interventions described, including follistatin gene therapy which the author personally underwent, are experimental, are not approved by the FDA or other regulators for anti-aging or muscle-building use in healthy adults, and carry real risks. Do not start, stop, or change any diet, supplement, exercise, medication, or therapy based on this document. Consult a qualified healthcare professional who knows your individual situation.ABSTRACT: Common intuition treats aging as the inevitable cost of elapsed time. This paper offers a different, hopeful hypothesis: that biological aging is really the running balance between the damage a body sustains each day and its capacity to repair and renew itself. If that is true, then the calendar is a bystander, and the rate at which we age is something we can partly influence. The paper lays out eight everyday levers that tip this balance toward repair: managing metabolic stress, chronic psychological stress, nutrition, muscle, hydration, sleep, emotional and social connection, and the evidence-based use of modern medicine. It then looks to the frontier, where cellular reprogramming (the Yamanaka factors), follistatin gene therapy, and compounds such as the catechins in green tea and matcha may actively widen repair capacity. It also singles out the two great accelerators of damage, smoking and alcohol, and closes with a piece of arithmetic borrowed from investing: because a 10% loss requires an 11.1% gain to undo, damage is inherently harder to reverse than to prevent, and losses compound downward over a lifetime. Every scientific claim is tied to peer-reviewed literature.LANGUAGES: This record contains the paper in four languages — English (original), Russian, Malayalam, and Hindi. The translations reproduce the full text and all figures; labels inside the diagrams remain in English. The bibliography is given in English in all versions. This work has not been peer reviewed. Also archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21440268.

studies.title: The Most Commonly Consumed Beverages Among Orthodontic Patients Interacting With Color Changes of Orthodontic Appliances: A Pilot Questionnaire Study
studies.abstract: Introduction Nowadays, orthodontic patients are increasingly choosing aesthetic braces, retainers or aligners that change their color over time, making an impact on patient satisfaction and treatment outcomes [1,2]. Previous studies have shown that these color changes can originate from the consumption of daily beverages [3-6]. However, there were no studies focusing on orthodontic patients, thus this topic has not been thoroughly investigated. Aim The aim of this self-reported and collected survey data was to identify the most commonly consumed beverages among orthodontic patients interacting with color changes of orthodontic appliances. Methods To find out what beverages were most commonly consumed, a pilot questionnaire study was conducted. The questionnaires were anonymous and consisted of 17 closed-ended questions with possible answers, age, and gender. The inclusion criteria for participants: participants older than 18, currently having orthodontic appliances (braces, aligners, retainers). The questionnaire listed the most popular beverages consumed in previous studies and provided possible answers about the frequency of consumption of these drinks, e.g., once a day, once a week, etc. The questionnaire was posted in a Facebook group "BRACKETS! And everything related to teeth!" for 3 weeks. The power analysis with G*Power (Version 3.1.9.2) statistical software was used to determine the minimal sample size 378. IBM SPSS 28.0.1.1 was used for numerical analysis. A chi-square test was used to determine the difference in the prevalence of used beverages between the genders. A value of p<0.05 was considered significant. Results The survey was attended by 415 respondents from Lithuania: 234 women (56.38%) and 181(43.62%) men (P=0.09). The results of the study showed that cappuccino (23.40%) and black coffee (10.80%), black (8.00%) and green (9.40%) tea were most commonly consumed at least once a day. Meanwhile, Coca-Cola (36.40%), orange juice (15.40%), Fanta (9.10%), apple juice (8.50%), dark beer (4.10%) and red wine (2.20%) were most commonly consumed at least once a week. Carrot, beetroot, tomato juice and matcha were the least commonly consumed during the week (about 2%). Females consumed cappuccino (P=0.01), green tea (P=0.01), all juices (P varied from 0.01 t o 0.02) and red wine (P=0.03) statistically significantly more often than men. While men consumed black coffee (P=0.01), black tea (P=0.01) and dark beer (P=0.01) more often than females. The results correspond with the findings of previous studies that found black and green tea, black coffee, and Coca-Cola to be the most popular [7- 10]. A novelty of our research was that new beverages (cappuccino and dark beer) were included in this survey. Conclusions The most commonly consumed beverages among orthodontic patients were coffee, tea, and Coca-Cola. Therefore, these beverages should be included in future studies to evaluate their effects on the discoloration of esthetic orthodontic appliances.

studies.title: The Path to Matcha Repurchase: Ritual Attractiveness, Self-Congruence, and Preference
studies.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
studies.abstract: Abstract Rituals are deeply embedded into our culture and society, especially in the way we consume food. However, little literature are found that study rituals through the lense of consumer behavior especially in beverage industry. To better understand the impact of ritualized experience, a structural study of factors are design. A structural model was built to investigate the impact of consumer based self-congruence, product self-congruence self-congruence, and ritual experience on repurchase intention, with the underlying product preference as a potential mediator. This research used quantitative method, and seven hypotheses were proposed and study by collecting and analyzing empirical data using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) bootstrapping route analysis. The results of the empirical analysis reveal that the product preference process has the most direct effect on repurchase intention. Importantly, the results show that the two factors of actual self-congruence and product self-congruence did not show direct link with repurchase intention, nevertheless, both had extremely significant and favorable impact on the product preference variable. On the contrary, the Ritual Experience follows a robust partial mediation model and at the same time increases the consumer’s predisposition to repurchase the product. This research contributes to self-congruity and experiential marketing theory by mapping the exact cognitive limits of identity matching, and showing the dual-route, habit-forming robustness of ritualized consumption. The data also show a high impact of product preference on customers’ loyalty, preference and overall satisfaction. Keywords: Ritualized Experience, Consumer-Self Congruence, Product-Self Congruence, Repurchase Intention, Product Preference

studies.title: The possible Protective Effect of Matcha green tea against Acetic acid-induced colonic injury in Adult Albino Rats
studies.journal: Bundesinstitut für Risikobewertung Fachgruppe ZEBET - Datenbank und Informationsbeschaffung Abteilung Experimentelle Toxikologie und ZEBET
studies.abstract: The present experimental study aims to investigate the possible protective effect of Matcha green tea against acetic acid-induced colonic injury in adult male albino rats using histological, morphometric, and immunohistochemical methods.The study will be conducted at the Animal House, Faculty of Medicine, Sohag University. Thirty healthy adult male albino rats weighing 180–220 g will be used. The animals will be housed under standard laboratory conditions with free access to standard diet and water and will be acclimatized for one week before the experiment.The rats will be randomly divided into three equal groups, with 10 rats in each group. Group I will serve as the control group and will receive distilled water orally by gastric gavage once daily throughout the experimental period. Group II will receive a single intrarectal administration of 2 mL of 4% acetic acid solution (v/v in 0.9% saline) through a soft pediatric catheter measuring 2.7 mm in diameter. After administration, the animals will be maintained in a vertical position for approximately 2 minutes to prevent leakage. Group III will receive Matcha green tea orally by gastric gavage at a dose of 200 mg/kg body weight/day for 7 consecutive days. On day 8, the last Matcha dose will be followed by a single intrarectal administration of 2 mL of 4% acetic acid to induce colonic injury.All animals will be sacrificed 48 hours after acetic acid administration. Colon specimens will be removed, rinsed with normal saline, fixed in 10% neutral buffered formalin, processed for paraffin embedding, and sectioned at 5 µm thickness. The tissue sections will be stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and Alcian blue and examined using a light microscope. Immunohistochemical staining using an antibody against myeloperoxidase (MPO) will be performed to detect neutrophil infiltration and assess the possible anti-inflammatory protective effect of Matcha green tea.All experimental procedures will be performed according to approved ethical guidelines, with appropriate animal care, monitoring, humane handling, and adequate anesthesia

studies.title: The Price of Premium: A Case Study of “Ceremonial Matcha” and Social Media Myth-Making
studies.abstract: This article examines how social media and content creators construct the category of “ceremonial grade matcha” through digital mythmaking and explores the cultural, economic, and agricultural consequences of these representations. While matcha has deep historical roots in Japanese tea culture, the Western wellness market has redefined it as a superfood and lifestyle accessory. Through a qualitative textual and visual analysis of the hashtags #matcha and #ceremonialmatcha on Instagram and TikTok, supplemented by blogs and online guides, this study identifies recurring myths that frame ceremonial matcha as pure, premium, and spiritually enriching. Visual tropes such as pastel aesthetics, curated rituals with the chasen (茶筅, tea whisk), and comparative marketing strategies like “Matcha vs. Coffee” or “Ceremonial vs. Culinary” are used to authenticate products while flattening cultural complexity. The findings suggest that these myths operate more as marketing strategies than as cultural designations. “Ceremonial matcha” emerges as a Western construct that appropriates the symbolic weight of Japanese tea practices while detaching the term from its historical and cultural roots. This rebranding commodifies spirituality into lifestyle performance, confuses consumers with oversimplified binaries, and displaces the Japanese standpoint in defining quality. Moreover, the cycle of trend-driven consumption threatens to commodify and exhaust matcha as yet another disposable superfood, placing additional strain on Japanese agricultural systems and raising domestic prices. By decoding these myths, this article highlights how influencer-driven wellness narratives transform a centuries-old cultural practice into a consumable fantasy, underscoring the broader dynamics of Orientalism and commodification in global food culture.

studies.title: The Relationship Between Social Media Trends and Trade Flows: Analysing the Global Matcha Trend
studies.journal: Lund University Publications Student Papers (Lund University)
studies.abstract: This study aims to investigate how social media trends affect international trade through a study on the relationship between the global matcha tea trend and Japanese green tea exports. The study is performed in two steps, due to limitations in social media data access. Firstly, a time-series regression is used to analyse the relationship between global TikTok views and Google search intensity for matcha, finding a strong and economically meaningful positive association. Secondly, a gravity model of Japanese green tea exports to 148 countries over the period 2010-2025 is estimated using Google search intensity as a proxy for the social media trend. The regression is estimated with a Poisson Pseudo Maximum Likelihood estimator as well as importer and year-month fixed effects. The results from the preferred gravity specification do not show a statistically significant relationship between Google search intensity and exports. However, alternative specifications with less fixed effects reveal a positive association with statistical significance, suggesting that the matcha trend operates primarily as a global demand shifter rather than through importer-specific demand responses. The research performed and the model applied are new additions to literature on international economics, and the results highlight the relevance of future research with improved models to increase the understanding of social media trends’ effects on trade flows.

studies.title: THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN TIKTOK SOCIAL MEDIA EXPOSURE AND CHOICE OF MODERN DRINK AND NUTRITIONAL INTAKE OF MODERN DRINK AMONG ADOLESCENT FEMALE STUDENTS AT STATE SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL 5 PONTIANAK
studies.abstract: background : Trendy drinks are innovate beverages that are currently trending among teenagers, such as boba,cheese tea,thai tea,brown sugar coffe, and matcha latte. Their characteristics include unique flavours, attractive visuals,and high-calorie content. These drinks are often introduced and promoted through social media, particularly TikTok,quickly becoming popularand easily accessible to teenagers. objective : This study aimed to determine the relationship between exposure to TikTok social media and the choice of trendy drinks and nutritional intake among adolescent girls at SMA Negeri 5 Pontianak. Method : The study design was cross-sectional, with a sample of 64 eleventh-grade adolescent girls selected using a proportione random sampling technique. Data were collected through a TikTok exposure questionaire and a food frequency (FFQ), which were then analysed using the chi-square test. results : The results showed no significant relationship between exposure to TikTok and the choice of trendy drinks (p=0,067), but significant relationship between exposure to TikTok and nutritional intake of trendy drinks (p=0,000),with all respondents with excessive nutritional ontake coming from the high exposure group. conclusion : exposure to TikTok media influences the nutritional intake of trendy drinks but does not influence the choice of trendy drinks

studies.title: The Sounds of Uncertain Walls
studies.journal: Griffith Research Online (Griffith University, Queensland, Australia)
studies.abstract: The Sounds of Uncertain Walls, released in 2026 as an EP, is an improvised studio recording production, invoking the studio as a compositional tool: Nozomi Omote's improvised vibraphone performance was recorded and extended in the studio by Thomas Green through similarly spontaneous production processes. Found sound and bricolage were incorporated, including Japanese wind, rain and river recordings, and the sounds of a traditional matcha tea ceremony performed by Nozomi Omote. The piece aims to inhabit a tone: calm, hovering, faintly uncanny, and deliberately unhurried. The composition itself is the research: a practical exploration of how spontaneous performance, recording, editing, and environmental sound can be braided into one coherent artistic statement. Thomas and Nozomi collaboratively desgined the EP artwork.The project is inspired by Haruki Murakami’s novel, The City and Its Uncertain Walls, and attempts to translate the novel’s dreamlike atmosphere into sound, drawing on its balance of the ordinary and the strange. The work was requested by Ipswich Gallery for LightPlay, an installation requiring slow-moving, atmospheric music. In that setting the work functions less as a conventional EP than as a sonic environment, a quietly unfolding space in which the listener can drift, pause, and remain within a delicate suspension between material reality and fanciful suggestion.

studies.title: UPLC profiling of matcha extract capping biosynthesized copper oxide nanoparticles and their antimicrobial and cytotoxic potentials.
studies.abstract: This research demonstrates a green synthesis and subsequent functionalization process of copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) utilizing matcha green tea extract as a sustainable reducing and functionalizing agent. UPLC-MS analysis revealed the presence of significant bioactive phytochemicals, notably epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which is implicated in the reduction process. Thorough characterisation (XRD, FT-IR, SEM) verified the synthesis of pure, crystalline, monoclinic CuO NPs with an average size of 16-24 nm. The nanoparticles had considerable antibacterial activity, exhibiting robust efficacy against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 250 µg/ml. CuO NPs-matcha exhibited significant, dose-dependent cytotoxicity against MCF-7 and Caco-2 carcinoma cells, with IC₅₀ values of 122.1 and 161.9 µg/ml, respectively. Crucially, they demonstrated markedly reduced toxicity towards non-cancerous Vero cells (IC₅₀ = 333.2 µg/ml), yielding selectivity indices of 2.73 and 2.06, which confirms a favorable selective profile. Although the positive control doxorubicin showed greater potency (lower IC₅₀), the CuO NPs-Matcha demonstrated significantly higher selectivity for cancer cells, suggesting a potentially improved safety profile despite its lower efficacy. These findings underscore the matcha-synthesized CuO NPs as a highly promising and biocompatible nanomaterial for specific medicinal applications, particularly in antibacterial and anticancer therapies.

studies.title: Why Ceremonial Grade Matcha Is the Cleanest Green Drink Right Now
studies.abstract: In a world full of trendy beverages, one drink is quietly taking over wellness routines for all the right reasons. Matcha has always been popular, but today, Ceremonial grade matcha is being recognized as the cleanest and most effective green drink you can add to your daily life.

studies.title: Yerba mate i matcha – ziołowe napary jako trendy w zdrowym stylu życia: badania naukowe, tradycje kulturowe i praktyki kulinarne
studies.abstract: Yerba mate and matcha are herbal infusions with rich cultural traditions and confirmed health-promoting properties that are currently becoming trends in a healthy lifestyle. Yerba mate, valued for centuries by the Guarani Indians as a sacred herb and source of energy, is characterized by a complex chemical composition, including purine alkaloids, polyphenols, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, antiinflammatory, and chemopreventive effects. Its cultural significance, expressed through the cebar rituals and the social dimension of drinking, highlights yerba mate as a symbol of unity and hospitality. Matcha, powdered green tea, plays a key role in the Japanese tea ceremony Sado and is also valued for its high content of catechins, especially EGCG, which support cognitive functions, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, and positively influence lipid and glucose metabolism. In vitro studies also indicate matcha’s potential in cancer prevention through modulation of apoptosis and angiogenesis. This article integrates traditional, culinary, and scientific aspects, presenting yerba mate and matcha as valuable components of the modern functional diet.

studies.title: การเปรยบเทยบความสามารถตานอนมลอสระรวมของมทฉะลาเตทชงดวยนมประเภทตางๆ
studies.journal: Journal of Nutrition Association of Thailand (Online)
studies.abstract: Работа посвящена изучению аминокислотного состава разработанного мясосодержащего продукта. При разработке рецептуры особое внимание уделялось белковому составу сырья и расчету аминокислотного скора. Для увеличения количества белка, а также для улучшения аминокислотного состава было принято решение заменить фасоль на маш, который по своим ботаническим характеристикам мог бы возделываться на территории Саратовской области в качестве нового вида нетрадиционного сырья, решая проблему дефицита белка в регионе. Целью работы являлось изучение нутриентного потенциала и показателей качества мясосодержащих продуктов. Для достижения поставленной цели были определены следующие задачи: рассчитать аминокислотный состав мясосодержащих продуктов, проанализировать аминокислотный состав и рассчитать аминокислотный скор мясосодержащих продуктов. Объектом эксперимента служили мясосодержащие консервы из говядины с машем, обогащенные порошком тыквы (матча тыквы) и мукой из семян тыквы. В ходе расчета оценивалась биологическая ценность белков, определялся коэффициент утилитарности, коэффициент сбалансированности аминокислотного состава, коэффициент различий аминокислотного скора. Исследовано, что разработанный образец мясорастительных консервов имеет более обогащенный аминокислотный состав по сравнению с контролем. Так, содержание валина и изолейцина 5,52 г, лейцина 8,29 г, метионина+цистеина 3,57 г, треонина 4,30 г и триптофана 1,39 г, а также образец демонстрирует более высокое общее содержание белка – 197,15 г против 181,10 г в контроле. По аминокислотному скору в разработанном образце отсутствуют лимитирующие аминокислоты (все показатели >1), тогда как в контрольном образце метионин+цистеин является лимитирующим (скор 0,67). Разработанный образец характеризуется повышенной биологической ценностью (0,87 против 0,58), высоким коэффициентом сбалансированности (0,87 против 0,58) и сниженным коэффициентом разбалансированности (в 3,2 раза), что подтверждает улучшение качества белка. Таким образом, разработанный образец является более предпочтительным с точки зрения нутритивного качества и биологической эффективности по сравнению с контролем. The work is devoted to the study of the amino acid composition of the developed meat-containing product. When developing the formulation, special attention was paid to the protein composition of the raw materials and the calculation of the amino acid score. To increase the amount of protein, as well as improve the amino acid composition, it was decided to replace beans with mash, which, according to its botanical characteristics, could be cultivated in the Saratov region as a new type of non-traditional raw material, solving the problem of protein deficiency in the region. The purpose of the work was to study the nutritional potential and quality indicators of meat-containing products. To achieve this goal, the following tasks were defined: to calculate the amino acid composition of meat-containing products; to analyze the amino acid composition and calculate the amino acid score of meat-containing products. The object of the experiment was canned beef with mash, enriched with pumpkin powder (pumpkin matcha) and pumpkin seed flour. During the calculation, the biological value of proteins was estimated, the coefficient of utility, the coefficient of balance of amino acid composition, and the coefficient of differences in amino acid score were determined. It was investigated that the developed canned meat sample has a more enriched amino acid composition compared to the control, such as the content of valine and isoleucine 5.52 g, leucine 8.29 g methionine+cysteine 3.57 g, threonine 4.30 g and tryptophan 1.39 g, and also demonstrates a higher total protein content of 197.15 g versus 181.10 g in control. According to the amino acid score, there are no limiting amino acids in the developed sample (all indicators > 1), whereas in the control sample methionine+cysteine is limiting (score 0.67). The developed sample is characterized by increased biological value (0.87 versus 0.58), a high balance coefficient (0.87 versus 0.58) and a reduced imbalance coefficient (3.2 times), which confirms the improvement in protein quality. Thus, the developed sample is preferable in terms of nutritional quality and biological efficacy compared to the control.

studies.title: ¿Es el matcha una alternativa más saludable al café?
« L’esthétique Matcha Girl » : quand les réseaux sociaux façonnent un archétype féminin et redéfinissent les normes et pratiques de consommation du matcha
studies.journal: HAL (Le Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe)
studies.abstract: Ce mémoire explore comment les réseaux sociaux ont transformé le matcha en un objet symbolique incarné par la figure de la Matcha Girl. Plus qu’une boisson, le matcha devient ici le signe d’un style de vie idéalisé, féminin et esthétisé, où la consommation se charge de significations sociales et identitaires. L’analyse met en évidence que cette esthétique, diffusée massivement en ligne, construit une norme douce mais contraignante du « bien-être », qui valorise la discipline, la pureté visuelle et l’auto-contrôle. Elle révèle aussi les exclusions implicites que ce modèle véhicule, en réservant cet idéal à une élite sociale et corporelle précise, tout en gommant les racines culturelles japonaises du produit. Enfin, le travail souligne l’ambivalence des individus face à cette norme : entre adhésion, imitation et distanciation critique, ils rejouent les codes de la Matcha Girl tout en en percevant les limites. Ce mémoire invite ainsi à réfléchir aux imaginaires contemporains du bien-être et aux mécanismes par lesquels des pratiques banales deviennent des archétypes culturels façonnant nos manières de consommer et de nous représenter.

studies.title: 3M Microbial Material Matter: Evaluating Growth, Colouration, and Coating Methods for Bacterial Cellulose
studies.abstract: This study explores bacterial cellulose (BC) as a biomaterial for design applications, assessing how natural colouration and coatings influence its aesthetic properties, durability, and long-term performance. BC was modified with organic additives during growth (in-situ) and treated with various coatings post-drying (ex-situ). Unlike typical studies that assess biomaterials at a presumed point of readiness, this one-year evaluation revealed time-dependent material changes that were initially unnoticeable, emphasizing the need for long-term observation. Various natural pigments were incorporated in-situ, including beetroot, hibiscus, saffron, red cabbage, curry, coffee, henna, matcha, curcuma, and food dyes. Fermentation occurred at 21–26°C, pH 3.8–4.6, over 18–25 days. Beetroot-infused fermentation (330mL/L water) produced the most efficient BC growth, yielding ~8mm thick sheets in 25 days, surpassing ~5mm from black tea-based fermentation. Hibiscus extract (20g/L) provided a stable red hue, while other pigments varied in fade resistance and material strength. Ex-situ coatings, including wax, beeswax, and coconut oil, were applied post-drying. While coconut oil initially preserved flexibility better than wax, both coatings resulted in brittleness over time, highlighting the need for improved protective treatments. Post-growth dyeing with hibiscus and beetroot, enhanced coloration but increased fragility. BC sheets were integrated into wearables, lighting, and wall panels to evaluate performance, and monitored over one year for colour stability and environmental resistance. This study highlights the potential of natural pigmentation for BC, with beetroot and hibiscus proving the most effective in-situ pigments. However, coating limitations emphasize the need for further research to improve long-term flexibility and material integrity for sustainable design applications.
